Variants.Content: Marta Lys () is located at the junction of Slaver's Bay and the old world of Valyria. It is famous for its cruelty, abnormal legends and the shadow of ancient blood. Many of the stories about it come from traders and sailors, and rumors cannot be taken as verifiable facts; what is certain is that this is an area where heat, drought, trade routes, and Valyrian ruins interact.
Entry Mantarys Local families also relied on irrigation fields, brick kilns, harbors, caravans, and shipping along Slaver's Bay; if any road, well, or wharf failed, the cost would fall first on them.

Entry Mantarys They will also recognize the accents, laws, and credentials of the Guise Coast; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar, or horse's hoof.

Entry Mantarys If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

The craftsmen of Mata Lys rely on the stone walls, wooden beams, iron doors, tombs and seams left by generations of repairs to leave behind their craftsmanship, while the clergy use the gods of Ghis, the step pyramid and the hierarchical order of the ancient city-state to explain life and death. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Mantarys They care about irrigation lands, brick kilns, ports, caravans, and shipping along Slaver's Bay. They also look at whether seeds are left after grain collection and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
